path.description: The path read, relative to the workspace, with forward slashes.

size.description: The file's size on disk, in bytes.

binary.description: True when a NUL byte in the first 8 KiB says the file is binary; then text is null.

truncated.description: True when the file is larger than the 2 MiB read.

text.description: The first 2 MiB as UTF-8; null for a binary file.
